notes: Crowded zones now keep the last complete marker population visible when a replica snapshot exceeds the 512-marker render budget, instead of blanking and rebuilding the whole crowd.
Oversized snapshots allocate no new markers; ordinary reconciliation resumes as soon as the population returns within the rendering budget.
Still short of the mark: remote players remain placeholder capsules, and crowded zones have no authored level-of-detail treatment or player-facing overload cue.
title: Crowds hold their last stable frame
